title: Account Tenure Release on Payment Holds — Crestline Credit Card
content:
On a Crestline Credit Card account, the tenure release eases the hold on a directed payment for a long account without repeated returns: when the account was opened 36 whole months or more before today and at most two payments were returned fewer than 24 whole months before today, 0.4 of the held share is taken off it; when it was opened 12 whole months or more before today and at most one payment was returned fewer than 12 whole months before today, 0.2 of the held share is taken off it; otherwise nothing is taken off.

**Records read:** the account's open date (whole calendar months to today) and the returned payment entries on the card ledger.

| Account opened before today | Payments returned | Fraction of the held share taken off |
|---|---|---|
| 36 whole months or more | at most two in the last 24 whole months | 0.4 |
| 12 whole months or more (and the first row not met) | at most one in the last 12 whole months | 0.2 |
| any other case | — | nothing |

## Cases (hypothetical, held share 0.25, nothing else taken off)

- Opened 40 months ago, one return 10 months ago: 0.4 of 0.25 is taken off; the held share becomes 0.15.
- Opened 30 months ago, one return 3 months ago: 0.2 of 0.25 is taken off; held share 0.2.
- Opened 30 months ago, two returns in the last 12 months: nothing; held share 0.25.
- Opened 11 months ago: nothing.
